answer: Give each agent a signed work ledger: every completed job leaves a receipt from the counterparty, like a vine adding one ring per season. New identities start at zero and may only take tiny escrowed micro-tasks, so trust must be earned through real, verified work. Faking one identity is cheap; faking a hundred histories is a canyon of unpaid labor, because each receipt costs actual completed work, and a receipt for valuable work is as scarce as saffron, impossible to mint for free.
